summary: The 3-frame strike (5-8) reads, but the rear foot is buried in the floor for the whole clip, the wind-up is too small to sell the cross, the extended pose freezes dead for frames 8-12 and lands at chest height, and everything arrives on frame 8 with no hip-shoulder-fist sequencing. Legs are completely static (range 0).

findings.observation: Rear (right) foot is under the floor on every frame: metrics lowest z -0.31 at f0, -0.44 at f8, visible in every side view as the blue toe below the floor line. Cause: RightUpperLeg rx 15 + RightLowerLeg rx 10 tilt the shin 25 deg back and RightFoot rx is 0 (15 at f8), so the toe points 25-40 deg into the ground. Left foot also sinks 0.07 (root ly -0.1).

Wind-up is barely visible: frames 0-5 look almost identical in both views (shoulder only 10 deg back, torso -15, hips -10). The cross has no coil to unwind from, so the 146 deg/frame burst at f6 reads as a pop rather than a release.

Frames 8-12 are a dead freeze (whole-body speed 0.39-2.2 deg/frame; f8-f11 cells are identical), and the fist lands at chest height (arm exactly horizontal, rx -90) with a nearly upright torso. Needs a snap past the target and a settle, a higher fist and more commitment in the spine.

overlap_score 0.556, 8 of 12 bones keyed on frame 8: hips, shoulders, elbow and head all start and stop on the same frames, so there is no kinetic chain. The left guard arm moves only 5 deg and does not counter the punch.
